EARLY_FIRST_FULL_LOCALITY_EFFECT.note: The historical S2 first-full regime loses locality monotonically with depth; EXACT is nonmonotonic but ends below its N=9 hit ratio at N=100.

NO_PREFILL_DEPTH_EFFECT.note: Depth materially changes deterministic locality and the relative TPS regime.

S2_ADVANTAGE_DECAYS.note: The exceptionally large N=9 advantage shrinks substantially by N=100, although interior ratios are nonmonotonic.

S2_COMPENSATES_DECAY.note: Both endpoint policies lose locality from N=9 to N=100, while S2 retains positive locality and TPS advantages at every measured depth.

limitations: N=9 S2, N=100 EXACT and N=100 S2 reuse already-valid same-host endpoint evidence as authorized
interior points have one clean process per arm and establish deterministic curve shape rather than a host-noise confidence interval
output divergence is trajectory metadata only and is not semantic-quality evidence
